purpose: Phase 0 egress baseline workload manifest (docs/egress-implementation.md). Deterministic shapes for comparing legacy egress against the fabric during rollout. Record artifacts beside this manifest per host class.
invocation: scripts/build/bench-harness.sh && scripts/build/resource-limit.sh target/bench/test_harness <mode> (with the env rows below)
metrics: scale.csv columns: config,step,label,cpu_pct,rss_kb,ffmpeg_n,ffmpeg_rss_kb,total_rss_kb; summary.txt records rss_delta_kb and per_output_kb per config

workloads.shape: 1 SRT ingest fanned out to N healthy RTMP outputs against a mediamtx sink
workloads.hostScaleNote: Record the largest N this host sustains with all outputs advancing; 6-CPU/12GB WSL hosts record at N=100.

workloads.shape: 1 SRT ingest fanned out to N healthy SRT outputs against a mediamtx sink
workloads.knownFailure: Legacy SRT egress caps concurrent sender threads at 512 (src/media/engine_registries.rs sender_semaphore). N=1000 on the legacy path is recorded as an architectural failure, not a host limitation; the fabric must remove this cap.

workloads.shape: RTMP-heavy mixed fan-out approximating the recorded 1,140 RTMP + 60 SRT production shape
workloads.hostScaleNote: Both configs run sequentially in one process lifetime; per-config scale.csv rows keep the protocols attributable.

workloads.shape: healthy siblings share a pipeline with one stalled (non-reading) output; measures healthy progress and teardown behavior beside a dead destination
workloads.hostScaleNote: 6-CPU/12GB WSL hosts record at 32 siblings. The 998-healthy-plus-throttled variant additionally requires a rate-limited sink; the deterministic shard-thread analog is recorded in src/media/egress/shard/tests/leaf_isolation.rs.

workloads.shape: at least 25 percent of outputs lose their destination together and retry under admission limits
workloads.hostScaleNote: The mode exercises sink disappearance and retry-budget behavior; scale the output count with the host class.
